title: olax psittacorum
intro: Olax psittacorum, commonly known as Indian olive, is a plant species in the family Olacaceae, native to the tropical regions of Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include lowering cholesterol levels and blood pressure, and providing relief from anxiety and insomnia. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative properties. Bioactive constituents of Olax psittacorum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
